purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find why the downspout might be blocked.
activities.modelFrench: Une gouttière pleine peut obstruer la descente pluviale.
activities.modelEnglish: A full gutter can block the downspout.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the dumpster in French.
Listen and identify the French word for gutter.
Type 'Is the dumpster full?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: La benne à déchets est-elle pleine ?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask when the magnetic nail sweep is finished.
activities.modelFrench: Prévenez-moi quand le ramassage magnétique des clous est terminé.
activities.modelEnglish: Tell me when the magnetic nail sweep is finished.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the crew does with the trash.
activities.modelFrench: Utilisez le balai dans la cour et mettez les déchets dans la benne.
activities.modelEnglish: Use the broom on the yard and put the trash in the dumpster.

activities.modelFrench: Une section près de la cheminée n’est pas terminée.
activities.modelEnglish: One section next to the chimney is unfinished.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the punch list in French.
activities.modelFrench: la liste des points à terminer

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the phrase for remaining materials.
Type 'This is still open.' in French.
Ask which areas are still open for tomorrow.
activities.modelFrench: Le contremaître demande : « Quelles zones restent à terminer demain ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: Which areas are still open for tomorrow?

activities.modelFrench: Demain, la première tâche sera de terminer cette section.
activities.modelEnglish: Tomorrow the first task is to finish this section.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the order of tear-off and installation.
activities.modelFrench: D’abord la dépose, puis la pose.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the crew lead in French.
Listen and identify the French word for flashing.
Type 'Let's review today's roof plan before we start.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Passons en revue le plan de toiture d’aujourd’hui avant de commencer.
activities.modelEnglish: Let's review today's roof plan before we start.

activities.cueEnglish: Invite a coworker to walk the roof before calling the job complete.
activities.modelFrench: Parcourons le toit ensemble avant de déclarer le chantier terminé.
activities.modelEnglish: Walk the roof with me before we call the job complete.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what remains on the closeout punch list.
activities.modelFrench: Tout ce qui reste à faire demeure sur la liste des points à terminer pour la clôture.
activities.modelEnglish: Whatever is left stays on the punch list for the closeout.
